knowledgeAnswers.rationale: The load is split or an approved aid or route is used. Dragging is not a control, and the supervisor is told if the approved route is not available.
Early symptoms are reported the same shift so the task can be changed before harm becomes permanent.
Hearing loss from noise builds slowly, so the assessment is required to find and control the exposure.

practicalCriteria: Splits a named load into a size one person can control and uses the named trolley or lift
Explains the lift control when a team lift is used
Checks a named machine's noise and vibration exposure against the register before use
Reports a simulated symptom to the supervisor on the same shift
passRule: Knowledge checks are a reading check only and are not verified practical competence. Assessor must observe every practical criterion; any failure requires remediation and reassessment.
stopWorkCriteria: A load is carried alone beyond the person's control
A simulated symptom is not reported
A machine is run without the check the register requires
